related_questions.snippet: Effective July 31, 2025, New York will no longer require employers to provide paid sick leave to employees who contract COVID-19. As discussed in our prior alert, New York has required employers to provide COVID-19 leave since March 2020. Going forward, such leave will no longer be required.

related_questions.question: How many vacation days are required by law in NY?

text_blocks.snippet: In New York, there is no legal requirement for employers to provide paid or unpaid vacation days. While many employers offer vacation time as part of their employee benefits, it's not mandated by state law. If an employer chooses to offer vacation time, they must adhere to their own established policies and procedures regarding accrual, usage, and payout, according to the Bell Law Group and Complete Payroll.
